summary: Scoped "are you still there?" for one in-progress flow, warning before it resets.
overview: Scoped to a single flow — a form, a checkout — through explicit Start and End calls, and it warns before resetting rather than resetting silently. The standard public-kiosk safety net for a flow someone walked away from half-finished.
useCases: Resetting a part-completed form after the visitor leaves.
A countdown warning before clearing entered details.
Protecting personal data left on screen in a public place.

params.tuning: Measured from the last meaningful ACTION, not the last frame.
The countdown window before the reset. Too short and nobody can react to it.

gotchas.title: Call NotifyActivity on real actions, not every frame
gotchas.body: Pushing the timeout out on every frame means it never fires, which defeats the point. A button press or a field edit is the right trigger.

gotchas.title: Distinct from IdleAttractManager
gotchas.body: That one watches the whole kiosk to trigger an attract screen. This one is scoped to one flow and is started and ended explicitly.
